visual_action: A still photo of the entrance to a polling place, with a "VOTE HERE" sign in the foreground and people in line in the background. A digitally superimposed character, a man in a white t-shirt and jeans, performs a quirky dance in front of the sign for the duration of the video.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account.

on_screen_text.text: If you're in line stay in line, your vote matters !!

audio_music: An upbeat, funky instrumental track plays throughout, creating an energetic and positive mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a static image with a single animated element superimposed on top. There are no cuts or camera movements.
manipulation_or_satire: A digitally cutout character (Napoleon Dynamite) is superimposed onto a still photo of a polling place and animated to look like he is dancing. This is done for humorous and attention-grabbing effect.
cultural_references: The dancing character is Napoleon Dynamite, from the 2004 film of the same name. His shirt reads "VOTE FOR PEDRO," a direct reference to a famous plot point in the movie, and his dance moves mimic the film's iconic dance scene.
central_claim: Voters who are in line when polls close should remain in line, as they are still entitled to vote and their participation is important.
intended_effect: To encourage voters waiting in long lines to not give up, using a humorous pop-culture reference to make the message memorable and shareable.
